name: Shea butter on skin, hair and babies
what_people_do: Rub raw or whipped shea butter on skin, scalp, hair and babies as a daily moisturiser.
why_they_say_it_works: Traditional West African emollient, called gentle and healing.

documented_by.source: Micali G et al 2018, G Ital Dermatol Venereol, PMID 29368843
documented_by.quote_or_summary: No opened survey of use. Evidence summarised from agent4. UNVERIFIED as documentation.

evidence.tested: Shea-containing combination device for atopic dermatitis
evidence.finding: Efficacy of a branded combination; shea cannot be isolated as the active.

source.name: Micali G et al 2018, G Ital Dermatol Venereol, PMID 29368843

harm_note: Latex allergy with raw shea (Cleveland Clinic, in the bank entry).
gaps: No trial of plain shea butter.
